memo: Only one change helped: Morgan radius 2 to 1 (slot 24), scoring 0.4382/0.4336 over 2 runs. The incumbent mean_adjusted is 0.4359, against the 0.4417 baseline. Radius 3 hurt (0.4637), so simpler, shorter-range features generalize better to unseen scaffolds. Radius 1+2 concatenated gave 0.4458, and 1024 bits gave 0.4460. Both are worse than the incumbent. The Random Forest regularization and tuning changes all hurt: more trees 0.4531, min_samples_leaf 3 0.4605, min_samples_leaf 10 0.5079, MAX_FEATURES 0.2 0.4536. Every boosting swap was worse too: XGBoost 0.4614/0.4641, CatBoost 0.4571, GradientBoosting 0.4666, LightGBM 0.4755. Many slots were lost to patch_fail or crashes. The descriptor attempts (slots 33 and 34) crashed on an import error, so no descriptor result exists yet. Next: copy SEARCH text exactly and keep edits tiny. Then try radius 1 with count-based Morgan, a few RDKit descriptors added (using the correct rdkit.Chem.Descriptors import), a target transform, and an RF+CatBoost average. Gaps under 0.004 are noise.
